page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of bundled local storage and GPUs allows organizations to allocate budget strictly toward high-density CPU compute and network throughput, avoiding expenditures on unused hardware resources.

Given its high core count and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is engineered for compute-heavy workloads. Suitable applications include high-traffic web serving, batch processing, scientific modeling, video encoding, and distributed analytics frameworks that require significant parallel processing capabilities without massive memory footprints.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory. Powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.7 GHz under the KVM hypervisor, this server provides a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. It offers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps but does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. This hardware profile is designed for compute-intensive workloads where processing power and network throughput are prioritized over local disk space or high memory-per-core ratios. The absence of bundled local storage allows for qualitative cost efficiency by letting users scale block storage independently. It is suited for workloads such as batch processing, web serving, video encoding, and parallel computing tasks.
